purpose: Exact-SKU knowledge for local app authoring; not a runtime capability registry

field_semantics.hardware: Plain SKU, including its explicitly bundled base; optional accessories excluded
field_semantics.null: Unknown, unverified, or not applicable; consult the adjacent status or presence field
field_semantics.false: Absent in this SKU or not implemented in the stated preview baseline; never transfer between namespaces
field_semantics.resolution_px: Manufacturer's listed display pixel dimensions, not a universal driver rotation-zero mapping
field_semantics.rotated_sizes_px: Geometric width/height possibilities derived from 90-degree rotations, not tested firmware outputs
field_semantics.body_dimensions_mm_as_published: Dimensions in the manufacturer's published order; not a screen-placement model
field_semantics.runtime_profile: Exact identifier in runtime/data/device-profiles.json; existence does not prove hardware or host-media fidelity
field_semantics.native_preview: Shipped MCP adapter contract, gated by actual native worker capability; separate from physical hardware and legacy optional demos
field_semantics.browser_preview: Local browser adapter; capture/output requires explicit user action and host support; native mapping is declared separately
field_semantics.physical_firmware: Implemented board adapter and explicitly scoped physical acceptance; does not imply all peripherals are supported

camera_status_semantics.listed_present: Official specification explicitly identifies onboard camera hardware
camera_status_semantics.explicitly_absent: Official comparison or compatibility statement explicitly excludes a camera
camera_status_semantics.not_listed_unverified: Official component list has no camera entry; present remains null, not inferred false
camera_status_semantics.native_preview.camera_adapter: Separate implementation flag; false for all five records in this release

rotation_contract.implementation_guidance: Select rotation explicitly, then query display.width()/height(); verify physical orientation and touch coordinates per board/revision. Do not copy a generic default into a SKU contract.
rotation_contract.shake_animation: bounded shell animation; reduced-motion suppresses transient movement

preview_baseline.microphone: app-requested local PCM16 at 16 kHz mono
preview_baseline.speaker: CoreS3/SE/StickS3 mono PCM16 at 8–48 kHz; up to 30 seconds per clip
preview_baseline.default_shell: fixed generic device controls and host audio settings
preview_baseline.physical_firmware: CoreS3 SE: display/touch/buttons/mono exclusive audio. AtomS3R: display/button/semantic motion and Wi-Fi/HTTP(S). StickS3: display/KEY1/KEY2/semantic motion/mono exclusive audio. All three have scoped deployment, original-firmware restore and restart acceptance; CoreS3 standard and StickC Plus2 remain emulator-only.
preview_baseline.network: Optional bounded GET/JSON POST on all five emulator profiles. Firmware adapters on AtomS3R, CoreS3 SE and StickS3; Atom has prior physical Wi-Fi acceptance; SE/Stick public API, saved-settings power cycle and forget/reprovision accepted October 20. Private USB setup, saved credentials, optional reconnection and explicit forget. Public service calls run on device Wi-Fi without a Mac server.

selection_rules: Match exact SKU before selecting a profile
Never alias K150 to K016-P2 because display resolution matches
Never alias K128-SE to K128 because motion hardware differs
Do not infer microphone, speaker or battery on plain C126 from an attached Voice Base
Unknown requested SKU must remain unsupported until its profile and adapters are implemented and validated
evidence_status: See runtime/docs/release-validation.md; physical claims require board tests.
